关于露营营地的故事(A Story about the camping site: 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:米娅与山姆的经历和小计划。

Last Monday, Mia and Sam went to the camping site. Mia wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the camping site by bike. Also, the fuel gauge shows the tank is almost empty.
Sam is interested in cooking. Mia drinks water after doing sports. Mia thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. The birds built a nest under the roof.
Mia is going to travel to Toronto in September. Both of them like noodles and water. The camping site is one of the best places in the city. She was unhappy about the noise.
Mia spent the weekend at the bookstore. Mia learned a lot about math. There are always many people at the forest path.
